Description.value: Zombies only snarl, groan and grunt when they can actually see you. A zombie chasing you through a wall, sniffing you out from the next room or swinging at a door you are behind keeps its voice down; step into its sight and it sounds off as usual. Each kind of vocal can be muted, made rare or left alone in-game. Hurt, death, footsteps and impacts are never touched. Compatible with Undead Legacy.
